How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's how to taste whisky properly for the first time:
Step 1: Smell First (The Aroma)
Gently bring the glass up to your nose — don't rush this!
Take your nose away after each sniff, then repeat — the layers will slowly reveal themselves
Try to identify familiar smells — the tasting notes in your box will help guide you
Give your nose a break between samples with fresh air and water
Step 2: Taste (The Palate)
Take a small sip and roll the whisky over your tongue and around your mouth
Savor the flavors — are they woody? Fruity? Spicy? Herbal?
Notice the texture and intensity (the "mouth-feel")
Pro Tips:
Use the tasting notes that come in your box to help identify what you're experiencing
Have water handy to cleanse your palate between samples
Don't worry about getting it "right" — it's about discovering what YOU enjoy!
